[Reason]
The bed is the largest fixed element, so it is centered against the north wall with a nightstand on each side, satisfying the requirement that the bed sit between them. The wardrobe and dresser occupy opposite side walls without narrowing the central circulation route. The writing desk is placed along the south wall with its chair facing the work surface. The armchair is centered beyond the foot of the bed and faces it, with a side table and floor lamp nearby to form a reading area. Small accessories are distributed across the nightstands, dresser, desk, and side table, while wall decor is arranged above major furniture and on otherwise open wall sections. Clear gaps remain around the bed, between seating pieces, and through the room center.
[/Reason]
</reasoning>
